title: Status model reads worker activity and attempt reports
description:
Epic hn6, wave 2: the per-attempt readers the dashboard shows from THIS machine. (1) Worker activity (hn6 rule 5: activity sparkline + last tool action + stuck nudges) goes in internal/statusmodel/activity.go. (2) The attempt report summary and diff stats (the drill-in view: "report summary, diff stats") go in internal/statusmodel/report.go. Both are read-only, bounded, and return nil when there is nothing to read. Cloud runs pass nil readers.

The wave-1 contract tick declared the fields and stubs. Worker.activity is {window_seconds, buckets, last_action, last_action_at, nudges} and Worker.handle. Tick.report is {summary, diff{files,insertions,deletions}}. The stubs are Sources.Activity / Sources.Report and the exported constructors TranscriptActivity(home) and AttemptReports(repo, runID), already wired into localStatusModel in internal/cli/status_model.go. Read internal/statusmodel/statusmodel.go and those stubs first.

1) activity.go:
- `TranscriptActivity(home string) func(executor, worktree string) *ActivityInput` reads the worker harness's session transcript. Reuse internal/exec/subprocess: TranscriptDir(kind, cwd) finds the directory and classify() names events. The newest *.jsonl in that dir is the session. Read at most the last 256 KiB. Collect the timestamps of every dated line into Events. Set LastAction to a one-line summary (≤ 80 chars) of the LAST tool call: for pi/claude the tool name plus its first argument, e.g. "bash: go test ./internal/reconcile". If you need an exported helper in internal/exec/subprocess/activity.go, add it there: only this tick edits that file in this wave. The executor→kind mapping: an executor or model naming claude → "claude", otherwise "pi".
- `decorateWorkers(src, recs, m)`: for each worker, call src.Activity (when non-nil and the worktree is non-empty). Build activity with window_seconds = 600 and buckets = 10 one-minute counts of events in (now-600s, now], oldest first. last_action and last_action_at come from the input. nudges = the count of `stuck_nudged` feed lines for that (tick, attempt) (reconcile.StageStuckNudged); count them even when Activity is nil, and set activity to a struct with empty buckets in that case only if nudges > 0, else leave activity null. handle = the attempt record's JobHandle "agent" or "pane" or "name" string, when present (runstate.Attempt.JobHandle is a map; check what keys the herdr and subprocess executors write by grepping internal/exec/herdr and internal/exec/subprocess for job_handle), else null.

2) report.go:
- `AttemptReports(repo, runID string) func(tickID string, attempt int) *ReportInput`. The summary comes from the archived report.md (subprocess.FileReportArchive) beside the attempt record under the executor state root. Locate it the way internal/reconcile/dispatch.go priorReports/findAttemptState do. Reuse an exported helper if one exists; if not, walk ~/.ticfac/exec/*/runs/<runID>/<tick>/<attempt>/ for a report.md whose sibling attempt record names the tick. Honor the executor state root env override that reconcile honors, so tests use a temp dir. The summary is the first non-empty paragraph that is not a heading, ≤ 300 chars. The diff comes from `git diff --shortstat <merge-base>..<attempt branch>`, run in repo. The attempt branch is `ticfac/run-<runID>/tick-<tick>/attempt-<n>` (confirm the spelling in internal/reconcile). The merge base is against `ticfac/run-<runID>`. Use internal/gitbin if the repo runs git through it. DiffRead is false when the branch is gone.
- Results are immutable per (tick, attempt) once the attempt is settled, so cache them in a sync.Map inside the returned func. Two-second redraws must not spawn git every frame.
- `decorateReports(src, m)`: for every tick with a current attempt whose state is not dispatched, set report from src.Report. Leave it null when the reader returns nil.

Files: internal/statusmodel/activity.go, internal/statusmodel/report.go, new internal/statusmodel/activity_test.go and internal/statusmodel/report_test.go, and optionally internal/exec/subprocess/activity.go for an exported helper. Do NOT edit build.go, statusmodel.go, contract.json or anything in internal/cli.

Tests (headless: fixtures only, no herdr, no real ~/.pi; point TICFAC_TRANSCRIPT_HOME / HOME at t.TempDir(); the executor state root goes to a temp dir):
- TestActivityBucketsTranscriptEvents: a pi transcript with events at now-30s, now-90s, now-95s and now-700s → buckets [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,2,1], and last_action from the last toolCall.
- TestActivityCountsNudgesWithoutATranscript: 1 stuck_nudged line and no transcript → nudges 1.
- TestActivityIsNullWithNothingToSay.
- TestReportReadsSummaryAndDiff: a temp git repo with a run branch and an attempt branch adding 2 files (+10/-0), plus an archived report.md → summary and diff {2,10,0}. Tests that build a git repo are allowed in this package, but keep them fast (< 2s).
- TestReportIsNullWhenNothingIsArchived.
- TestReportCachesPerAttempt: the second call does not re-run git (count calls with an injected runner, or assert on timing-free call counting).
- Build output with these readers still validates against the contract.

Run: `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestActivity|TestReport|TestTheContract' ./internal/statusmodel/`. Must still pass: `go test -short -timeout 20m ./internal/statusmodel/ ./internal/exec/subprocess/ ./internal/cli/`, and then `make gate`.
acceptance_criteria: [1] Worker activity carries 10 one-minute buckets, last action and nudge count from the transcript and feed; attempt report carries summary and diff stats, cached per attempt. [2] `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestActivity|TestReport|TestTheContract' ./internal/statusmodel/` passes headless (temp dirs, no herdr, no real home). [3] `make gate` passes.
